name: loops
label: Loops
tagline: Beats and loops on a step grid, saved as WAV

help.about: Make beats and loops on a step grid and save them as WAV files in your Forge data folder.

manifest.summary: A step sequencer in the page (Web Audio): one row per instrument, click a step for a loud hit, again for a soft one. Tempo, swing, 8 to 32 steps, mute and volume per row. Patterns save as JSON in the data folder; Export WAV renders 1, 2, 4 or 8 repeats offline with the tail folded into the start, so the WAV loops without a gap, and writes it to ~/Music/Loops without replacing a file. instruments.json is the registry of instruments; static/voices.js holds the sound makers.
